item.title: Butternut Squash Cupcakes
item.description: Give pumpkin a break this fall, and try these cozy, fluffy, spiced butternut squash cupcakes/muffins—perfect for breakfast, snacking, and pairing with coffee!

item.title: Week 69 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 69 Meal Plan is full of simple and delicious recipes! From soups, pizza, to pumpkin pie, you'll enjoy saving time and money prepping these meals this week.

item.title: Vegan Stuffed Butternut Squash
item.description: This stuffed butternut squash with quinoa, mushrooms, and chickpeas is cozy, hearty, and a tasty vegan main for Thanksgiving & Christmas!

item.title: Week 70 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 70 Meal Plan is full of time and money-saving goodness! You'll enjoy vegan tacos, noodles, soups and more!

item.title: Easy Grape Sorbet (Red or Green)
item.description: This 3-ingredient grape sorbet is ultra-fresh, bursting with sweet grape flavor (red or green grapes!), and requires no special equipment for a simple summer sorbet!

item.title: Week 71 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 71 Meal Plan offers delicious recipes while also saving you time and money! From pasta, stews, tofu dishes, and more, you'll enjoy how simple these recipes are to make, too.

item.title: Week 72 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 72 Meal Plan offers easy, tasty, cost-saving meals. From soups, pot pies, chilis, and more, you'll save time in the kitchen prepping these simple vegan meals. Try out this Week 72 Meal Plan this week.

item.title: Vegan Peanut Butter Cups
item.description: 3-ingredient homemade vegan peanut butter cups are easy, fun to make, and every bit as creamy and indulgent as the original candy – perfect for a sweet tooth!

item.title: Vegan Peppermint Patties
item.description: These 4-ingredient vegan peppermint patties are creamy, minty, and coated in rich vegan chocolate — an easy, no-bake treat perfect for holiday gifting and year-round!

item.title: Week 73 Meal Plan
item.description: This Week 73 Meal Plan offers time and money-saving easy recipes! From soups, sandwiches, and easy vegan pizza rolls, you'll enjoy prepping these tasty recipes.
